messages:
lucy_marketing: Quick kickoff — Micro‑Summit next Wed 10am PT. 90min total (keynote + 3 breakouts). Target ~300 signups. Need: final reg page, Zoom orchestration, recording plan, and post‑event digest routing. Owners?

sam_ops: I can own Zoom config + greenroom. Will set up meeting, passcode, and breakout rooms.

mira_prod: I’ll own the registration page and form field mapping to HubSpot. Can we standardize the UTM/lead_source to `microsummit_2026`?

ben_sales: I’ll take lead routing rules: attendees get `attended=true` property, no-shows get `attended=false`. Segment for SDR follow up within 48h.

lucy_marketing: yes on `microsummit_2026`. Landing page must capture company, role, use-case checkbox (product/dev/infra). Add checkbox for consent to share with partners.

sam_ops: Zoom details draft: Meeting link: https://zoom.us/j/999888777 
Passcode: ms2026!
Cloud recording = enabled (one file, gallery + shared screen). Enable `Record active speaker, gallery view and shared screen` to get full session + separate audio file. Also enable `Allow participants to join before host` = off.

mira_prod: HubSpot mapping snippet for devs: `form.fields = ["email","first_name","last_name","company","role","use_case","utm_source","utm_medium","utm_campaign"]` and hidden `lead_source=microsummit_2026`. Also set `lifecycle_stage = lead` on submission.

sam_ops: Greenroom checklist (short):
- Host + cohost set in Zoom
- Test screen share (slides + demo VM)
- Mics checked, echo test
- Recording enabled and space in cloud account
- Breakout rooms pre-named (A: Product, B: Infra, C: GTM)
- Switch to co-host for breakout movement
I’ll post full checklist in #eng-oncall.

ben_sales: For routing: Use HubSpot workflow: if `attended=true` then tag `microsummit_attendee` and notify SDR queue `SDR_microsummit`. If `attended=false` then send N‑1 nurture: 24h drip with recording highlight + CTA.

lucy_marketing: Post-event assets plan: 1) 4hr post email to registrants with on‑demand link & top 3 highlights, 2) Day+2 segmented email (attendees vs no-shows) with CTA to book a demo, 3) Publish trimmed 10‑min highlights clip + transcript on site within 5 business days.

mira_prod: Recording postproc: export cloud recording -> transcribe with internal ASR -> generate SRT and short clip timestamps. I’ll create a shared folder: drive.redwood/microsummit/2865432100.

sam_ops: Deploybot note: `deploybot` uploaded a Zoom recording retention policy change earlier — will ensure cloud retention 30 days for this event.

deploybot: automated: Recording retention policy for account `redwood-marketing` set to 30 days (id: rp-2026-03).

ben_sales: Measurement / benchmark narrative: track registration->attend rate, avg watch time, MQLs generated, demo conversions within 14 days. We should compare against last quarter's webinar benchmarks and call out any deviation in the postmortem doc.

lucy_marketing: Agreed. Action items:
- mira_prod: finalize reg page by EOD Friday
- sam_ops: Zoom + greenroom checklist by Monday
- ben_sales: HubSpot workflows + SDR queue by Monday
- lucy_marketing: draft post emails and highlight script by Monday
If no blockers I’ll ship the event brief to the execs later today. :rocket:
